scoring_justification: Artifact CSV contains computed Delta_E and Delta_q; compare to paper-reported peak, trend, and charge transfer thresholds with tolerances accommodating method variation. T1 recompute from raw logs is infeasible; T0 is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds and trend rules for Delta_E and Delta_q derived from paper: peak ~0.55 eV at ~2.55 A, Delta_E <0.1 eV at 3.0 A, Delta_q negligible (≤0.1 e) for distances ≤2.8 A, Delta_q >0.1 e for distances ≥2.9 A.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.3, Fig.4, and conclusion text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct translation of paper statements into numeric thresholds and monotonic decrease rule.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact qualitative and quantitative findings reported in the paper.

outputs.description: CSV containing the HOMO-LUMO gap and charge transfer as a function of Si-Si bond length for distances 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 2.8, 2.9, 3.0 Å.

output_contract.notes: The checker validates trends and values within tolerances derived from the original SCF-Xα-SW results, adjusted for DFT method variation.

steps.description: Validate Delta_E peak near 2.55 A (0.45-0.65 eV), monotonic decrease after peak, Delta_E <0.1 at 3.0 A, and Delta_q thresholds as per paper.
